What
Two shared functions, so one definition each serves all 27 levels that place them
— 54 placements for two source changes.

loads the pointer and zeroes it in the jr $ra delay slot, which executes before
the return rather than after it:

jr $ra
sw $zero, 0x0($v0)     # delay slot

pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: match/core-small-20261015b
pullRequests.body:
What
Marks the 150 sixteen-byte kernel stubs of src/core as ASM_FUNC in place of INCLUDE_ASM.
Each of them is addiu $v1,$zero,N ; syscall ; jr $ra ; nop: the shape the EE kernel library
uses to enter the kernel, and not something a C compiler can emit — no pattern in the EE
backend (gcc/config/mips) produces syscall, and the plain-C rule leaves no source form that
reaches it. Nothing about them is a matching failure: they were assembly in the original too.
